_note: Pre-generated base explanations (offline). Filipino text needs a native-speaker spot check before the pitch. 'spoken' is what read-aloud says, never raw LaTeX.

body: Multiplying two binomials is like finding the area of a rectangle whose sides are split into parts.
For $(x+3)(x+3)$, each side is $x + 3$. Cut the square into four pieces: one $x^2$, two $3x$ strips, and one $9$.
Add every piece: $x^2 + 3x + 3x + 9 = x^2 + 6x + 9$. Every term on one side multiplies every term on the other side.
en.spoken: Multiplying two binomials is like finding the area of a rectangle whose sides are split into parts. For x plus 3 times x plus 3, cut the square into four pieces: one x squared, two strips of 3 x, and one 9. Add every piece: x squared plus 6 x plus 9. Every term on one side multiplies every term on the other side.

body: Ang pag-multiply ng dalawang binomial ay parang paghahanap ng area ng rectangle na hinati ang mga gilid.
Sa $(x+3)(x+3)$, bawat gilid ay $x + 3$. Hatiin ang square sa apat: isang $x^2$, dalawang $3x$, at isang $9$.
Pagsamahin lahat: $x^2 + 3x + 3x + 9 = x^2 + 6x + 9$. Bawat term sa isang gilid ay mina-multiply sa bawat term sa kabila.
fil.spoken: Ang pag-multiply ng dalawang binomial ay parang paghahanap ng area ng rectangle. Sa x plus 3 times x plus 3, hatiin ang square sa apat: isang x squared, dalawang 3 x, at isang 9. Pagsamahin lahat: x squared plus 6 x plus 9.

body: $(a+b)^2$ means $(a+b)(a+b)$. Picture a square with side $a + b$.
It has four pieces: $a^2$, $b^2$, and two $ab$ rectangles. So $(a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2$.
The middle term $2ab$ is the part that's easy to forget.
en.spoken: a plus b, squared, means a plus b times a plus b. Picture a square with side a plus b. It has four pieces: a squared, b squared, and two a b rectangles. So a plus b squared equals a squared plus 2 a b plus b squared. The middle term is the part that's easy to forget.

body: Ang $(a+b)^2$ ay $(a+b)(a+b)$. Isipin ang square na ang gilid ay $a + b$.
May apat na bahagi: $a^2$, $b^2$, at dalawang $ab$. Kaya $(a+b)^2 = a^2 + 2ab + b^2$.
Ang middle term na $2ab$ ang madalas makalimutan.
fil.spoken: Ang a plus b squared ay a plus b times a plus b. May apat na bahagi: a squared, b squared, at dalawang a b. Kaya a squared plus 2 a b plus b squared. Ang middle term ang madalas makalimutan.

body: The number outside multiplies every term inside: $3(x+4) = 3x + 12$.
With a negative outside, every sign inside flips: $-2(x-5) = -2x + 10$.
en.spoken: The number outside multiplies every term inside. 3 times x plus 4 is 3 x plus 12. With a negative outside, every sign inside flips.

body: Ang numero sa labas ay mina-multiply sa bawat term sa loob: $3(x+4) = 3x + 12$.
Kapag negative ang nasa labas, nagpapalit ang bawat sign sa loob: $-2(x-5) = -2x + 10$.
fil.spoken: Ang numero sa labas ay mina-multiply sa bawat term sa loob. Kapag negative ang nasa labas, nagpapalit ang bawat sign sa loob.

body: An equation is a balance. Whatever you do to one side, do to the other.
To move $+3$ across, subtract 3 from both sides, so it shows up as $-3$. To undo $2x$, divide both sides by 2.
en.spoken: An equation is a balance. Whatever you do to one side, do to the other. To move plus 3 across, subtract 3 from both sides. To undo 2 x, divide both sides by 2.

body: Ang equation ay parang timbangan. Anuman ang gawin sa isang side, gawin din sa kabila.
Para ilipat ang $+3$, ibawas ang 3 sa magkabilang side, kaya magiging $-3$. Para alisin ang $2x$, i-divide sa 2 ang magkabilang side.
fil.spoken: Ang equation ay parang timbangan. Anuman ang gawin sa isang side, gawin din sa kabila.

body: Multiplying powers with the same base adds the exponents: $x^3 \cdot x^2 = x^5$.
A power of a power multiplies them: $(x^2)^3 = x^6$.
en.spoken: Multiplying powers with the same base adds the exponents. A power of a power multiplies them.

body: Sa pag-multiply ng powers na pareho ang base, ina-add ang exponents: $x^3 \cdot x^2 = x^5$.
Sa power ng power, mina-multiply: $(x^2)^3 = x^6$.
fil.spoken: Sa pag-multiply ng powers na pareho ang base, ina-add ang exponents. Sa power ng power, mina-multiply.

body: Like terms have the same variable part. Add their numbers and keep the variable: $4x + 3x = 7x$.
$2x$ and $3$ aren't like terms, so $2x + 3$ stays as it is.
en.spoken: Like terms have the same variable part. Add their numbers and keep the variable. 4 x plus 3 x is 7 x.

body: Ang like terms ay may parehong variable. I-add ang mga numero at panatilihin ang variable: $4x + 3x = 7x$.
Hindi like terms ang $2x$ at $3$, kaya mananatili ang $2x + 3$.
fil.spoken: Ang like terms ay may parehong variable. I-add ang mga numero at panatilihin ang variable.

body: To add fractions, first rewrite them with the same denominator: $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{3}{6} + \frac{2}{6} = \frac{5}{6}$.
Watch the signs: $-\frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{3}{4} + \frac{2}{4} = -\frac{1}{4}$.
en.spoken: To add fractions, first rewrite them with the same denominator. One half plus one third is three sixths plus two sixths, which is five sixths.

body: Para mag-add ng fractions, gawing pareho muna ang denominator: $\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{3} = \frac{3}{6} + \frac{2}{6} = \frac{5}{6}$.
Bantayan ang sign: $-\frac{3}{4} + \frac{1}{2} = -\frac{1}{4}$.
fil.spoken: Para mag-add ng fractions, gawing pareho muna ang denominator.

body: Same signs multiply to a positive; different signs multiply to a negative: $(-4)(-6) = 24$.
Adding a negative moves left on the number line: $24 + (-7) = 17$.
en.spoken: Same signs multiply to a positive. Different signs multiply to a negative. Adding a negative moves left on the number line.

body: Kapag pareho ang sign, positive ang product; kapag magkaiba, negative: $(-4)(-6) = 24$.
Ang pag-add ng negative ay paggalaw pakaliwa sa number line: $24 + (-7) = 17$.
fil.spoken: Kapag pareho ang sign, positive ang product. Kapag magkaiba, negative.

body: The square root asks: what number times itself gives this? $\sqrt{81} = 9$ because $9 \cdot 9 = 81$.
Square roots don't split across addition: $\sqrt{9 + 16} = 5$, not $3 + 4$.
en.spoken: The square root asks what number times itself gives this. The square root of 81 is 9.

body: Ang square root ay nagtatanong: anong numero ang kapag mina-multiply sa sarili ay ito? $\sqrt{81} = 9$ dahil $9 \cdot 9 = 81$.
Hindi puwedeng hatiin ang square root sa addition: $\sqrt{9 + 16} = 5$, hindi $3 + 4$.
fil.spoken: Ang square root ay nagtatanong kung anong numero ang kapag mina-multiply sa sarili ay ito.

body: If $(x+3)^2 = 49$, then $x + 3$ is a number whose square is 49: either $7$ or $-7$.
So $x + 3 = \pm 7$, which gives two answers.
en.spoken: If x plus 3 squared equals 49, then x plus 3 is either 7 or negative 7. That gives two answers.

body: Kung $(x+3)^2 = 49$, ang $x + 3$ ay numerong 49 ang square: $7$ o $-7$.
Kaya $x + 3 = \pm 7$, at dalawa ang sagot.
fil.spoken: Kung x plus 3 squared ay 49, ang x plus 3 ay 7 o negative 7. Dalawa ang sagot.

body: Get everything on one side so it equals 0, then factor.
If $(x-2)(x-3) = 0$, one of the factors must be 0, so $x = 2$ or $x = 3$.
en.spoken: Get everything on one side so it equals zero, then factor. If a product is zero, one of the factors must be zero.

body: Ilipat lahat sa isang side para maging 0, saka i-factor.
Kung $(x-2)(x-3) = 0$, isa sa mga factor ay 0, kaya $x = 2$ o $x = 3$.
fil.spoken: Ilipat lahat sa isang side para maging zero, saka i-factor.

body: Factoring undoes multiplying. For $x^2 + 5x + 6$, find two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to 5: 2 and 3.
en.spoken: Factoring undoes multiplying. Find two numbers that multiply to 6 and add to 5. They are 2 and 3.

body: Ang factoring ay kabaligtaran ng multiplication. Sa $x^2 + 5x + 6$, hanapin ang dalawang numerong 6 ang product at 5 ang sum: 2 at 3.
fil.spoken: Ang factoring ay kabaligtaran ng multiplication. Hanapin ang dalawang numerong 6 ang product at 5 ang sum.

body: Factor the top and bottom first, then cancel common factors: $\frac{x^2-9}{x+3} = \frac{(x+3)(x-3)}{x+3} = x - 3$.
en.spoken: Factor the top and bottom first, then cancel common factors.

body: I-factor muna ang itaas at ibaba, saka i-cancel ang magkaparehong factor: $\frac{x^2-9}{x+3} = x - 3$.
fil.spoken: I-factor muna ang itaas at ibaba, saka i-cancel ang magkaparehong factor.

body: For $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$: $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.
en.spoken: x equals negative b, plus or minus the square root of b squared minus 4 a c, all over 2 a.

body: Para sa $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$: $x = \frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2 - 4ac}}{2a}$.
fil.spoken: x ay negative b, plus o minus ang square root ng b squared minus 4 a c, lahat over 2 a.
